item.title: Telangana Updates Open Access Regulations to Clarify REC Treatment
item.description: The Telangana Electricity Regulatory Commission (TGERC) has notified the First Amendment to the Terms and Conditions of Open Access Regulation, 2024, introducing changes related to the issuance of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) for unutilised banked renewable energy. The amendment has been notified as Regulation No. 2 of 2026 and comes into force from the date of its publication in the Telangana Gazette on January 24, 2026. item.title: Kim Long Motor Partners BYD to Develop $130 Million EV Battery Plant in Vietnam
item.description: Vietnamese automobile manufacturer Kim Long Motor has announced a partnership with China’s BYD to develop a $130 million battery manufacturing facility for commercial electric vehicles in central Vietnam. According to a company statement issued on Tuesday, Kim Long Motor will finance the construction of the plant, while BYD will provide comprehensive technical and technological support under the agreement. item.title: AP: KOSOL Energie, Hoymiles Ties Up for 360 MW Microinverter Supply for Rooftop Solar Project
item.description: KOSOL Energie Pvt. Ltd., a renewable energy solutions provider, signed a formal agreement with the Andhra Pradesh Government to deploy one of the largest distributed rooftop solar projects, covering 1.5 lakh homes across the state, as part of the PM Suryaghar Yojana. Notably, Kosol Energie signed a 360 MW microinverter supply agreement in partnership with global smart energy technology leader Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc. item.title: Suzlon Secures Its First 248.5 MW Wind Order From ArcelorMittal
item.description: Pune-based wind solutions provider Suzlon Group has secured a 248.85 MW wind energy order from the ArcelorMittal Group through its renewable energy entity in India. The company said in a press release that the order is part of a 550 MW hybrid project in Gujarat. The project is to be executed in Bachau, Gujarat Suzlon explained that the wind capacity will be used for captive consumption at ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel facilities in India. item.title: Tata Power Renewables crosses 10 GW EPC Execution Milestone
item.description: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL), one of India’s leading renewable energy companies and a subsidiary of The Tata Power Company Limited, has commissioned 10 GW of EPC projects till date thereby underscoring its position as a leading player in the renewable energy sector. TPREL has commissioned 10 GW of EPC projects till date, which comprise 9.7 GW of solar projects and 290 MW of wind projects. item.title: Nextpower Arabia Secures 2.25 GW Bisha Solar Tracker Order In Saudi Arabia
item.description: Nextpower Arabia, the newly formed joint venture between Nextpower (formerly Nextracker) and Abunayyan Holding has announced its first big project win. It will provide 2.25 gigawatts (GWp) of solar tracking systems to Larsen & Toubro (L&T), the EPC for the Bisha Solar project. The project is being developed by an ACWA Power-led consortium. item.title: Hindalco Commissions India’s First Battery-Grade Aluminium Foil Plant in Odisha
item.description: Hindalco Industries Ltd, the metals flagship of the Aditya Birla Group, has announced a major expansion of its aluminium operations in Odisha. Hindalco has commissioned a 1.7 lakh-tonne-per-annum Flat Rolled Products (FRP) and battery-grade aluminium foil manufacturing facility, developed with an investment of ₹4,500 crore. item.title: Zambia Ties Up With Longi Solar, Sino Green on 100 MW Pilot Solar Plant
item.description: The Zambian Government, through the Ministry of Energy, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Longi Solar Technology and Sino Green Technology to implement and develop a 100 megawatt (MW) pilot solar power plant. Zambia government spoke in a social media post about operationalizing the project in April 2026 in the Itezhi-Tezhi District It plans to complete each solar plant under the partnership between eight and 10 months.
